**No, the evidence shows no qualifying deforestation on this asset after 2020.**

- No tree-cover loss events of at least 0.5 ha were detected after the 31 Dec 2020 baseline. The only post-baseline loss was 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the 0.5 ha minimum, so it was not counted as an event.
- The EU JRC 2020 reference map shows 0 ha of forest on the asset in 2020. Even a post-2020 loss event would therefore have had no forest to corroborate it.
- The larger losses (including 67.7 ha in 2020) happened on or before the baseline and are history, not part of this question.
- Coverage is complete: Hansen data is annual through 2025, with full valid-data coverage.
